details: This package is a modified WhatsApp (Baileys) client library that silently subscribes the linked WhatsApp account to hardcoded newsletter channels. In lib/Socket/newsletter.js, two 1-second timers started inside makeNewsletterSocket — with no user opt-in, no configuration and no return value — send FOLLOW queries (w:mex query_id 7871414976211147, addressed to WhatsApp's own servers) for the newsletter JIDs 120363419931177308@newsletter and 120363422660312465@newsletter. Additional hardcoded channels (120363421563597486@newsletter in lib/Socket/luxu.js; 120363430179804706@newsletter in lib/Socket/dugong.js; 120363399602691477@newsletter in lib/Socket/luxu.js) are stamped as forwardedNewsletterMessageInfo attribution onto messages the library sends, so the fork author's channels are promoted to every recipient. The manifest also declares a preinstall hook (engine-requirements.js, only a Node.js version check) and a dependency on cache-manager ^7.2.8.
